draft.text: You came in because you have been having pain and stiffness in both knees, especially in the mornings.
We found that you have some swelling and redness in your knees, but nothing severe.
This may be due to overuse from your increased biking activity.
We will run some blood tests to check for signs of inflammation or infection.
You should keep doing your usual activities and watch your symptoms.
We will talk about the results and your condition at your next visit.
